 L.K.L.P. LIHEAP Fall Subsidy Applications Open
 today November 10, 2026 
 18 
 share 
 close 
 email 
 Applications are now being accepted for Kentucky’s LIHEAP Fall Subsidy, which helps eligible households with heating costs. 
 In Letcher County and the other counties served by LKLP—Leslie, Knott and Perry—applications will be accepted through December 18, or until funding runs out. The program provides a one-time payment of $21 to $250 directly to a household’s energy vendor. 
 To qualify, household income must be at or below 150 percent of the federal poverty guidelines. You do not need a past-due bill or a disconnection notice to apply. Funding is available on a first-come, first-served basis. 
 Contact your local LKLP outreach office for application details. 
 Written by: Jamey Johnson
